settings.heading: Christmas Camp
settings.description: Santa is coming to the Farm Tour!
settings.content:
‘Kids Free’ events are offered by the Rotorua Heritage Farm celebrating Christmas. The Rotorua Heritage Farm invited Santa to visit us on Christmas Day and allow free admission for children who want to go on the Farm Tour. For this time only, Santa will drive a tractor and tour with your family, Santa will conduct a sheep dog herding and sheep shearing show by himself. An adult must accompany each child on the tour.

This will give your children a fun and memorable Christmas. Moreover, the 3D Trick Art Gallery is in the same area of the Rotorua Heritage Farm and offers free admission for children too. You can enjoy a magical journey at the 3D Trick Art Gallery either before or after the Farm tour with Santa. Participating in this event will make your Christmas very special and memorable.
